title: NetworkMachineRolesChangedPayload
description: network.machine.roles_changed v1 (OpenVibe.Network, plan L34, step M4). A machine's roles changed: the whole set after the change, from the catalogue (network.machine-roles@1). The machine applies them at its next check-in, so this event says what was asked for, not what the machine has already done. Envelope: subject { type: machine, id: <dev_…> }, visibility internal, actor service:network.

owner.description: The person the machine belongs to.

roles.description: The machine's roles after the change.

changed_by.description: Who asked for the change: the person, or an app acting with their consent.
